name: Jev Chat Assistant for macOS
description: macOS floating-window chat copilot: when the chat app is frontmost it reads the visible conversation via window-cropped screenshots + Apple Vision OCR (or the accessibility text API), sends the message to Jev for an 8-way intent Choice and a 0-9 risk Score — or to a local decider-2b model for fully offline judging — then drafts candidate replies in 14 tones with a separate chat model, re-ranks them locally, and fills the picked reply into the input box without sending or synthesizing keystrokes.
